messages.content: You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
ugh can I switch from annual to monthly plan midyear??

I don't have that detail in my information about switching between Annual and Monthly plans mid-year. Please email support@teacrafters.com or call 1-800-TEA-CRAFT for help. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
Do I need to be a subscriber to send a gift?
I don't have that detail about whether a non-subscriber can buy a gift. Please email support@teacrafters.com or call 1-800-TEA-CRAFT for help. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
Do you offer a discount if I pause instead of cancelling?
I don't have that detail. Please contact support@teacrafters.com or call 1-800-TEA-CRAFT for information on any discounts. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
skip
You can skip a month in 'Subscription Settings'. The change must be made at least 7 days before the next shipment. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
Can I order a sample pack before committing to a subscription?
I don't have information about sample packs. Please contact support@teacrafters.com or 1-800-TEA-CRAFT to ask whether one is available. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
Can I get a replacement for the white tea? It came in a bag that was clearly already open.
Please send a photo of the opened bag to support@teacrafters.com within 14 days of delivery and we'll send a free replacement. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
How do I cancel my subscription?
You can cancel in 'Subscription Settings'. The change must be made at least 7 days before the next shipment on the 1st of the month. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
Is there a discount for the annual plan? My budget is tight lol
Yes, the Annual plan saves you 15% and is billed once a year, compared with the Monthly plan at $24 per box. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
Do you refund shipping costs on returns?
I don't have details on refunds for shipping costs on returns. Please contact support@teacrafters.com or call 1-800-TEA-CRAFT. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
Can I leave feedback on a specific tea?
Yes, leave a review in the 'Customer Reviews' section of the product page. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
Hi, could you tell me the shipping cost to Australia?

Costs for international shipping are listed on the 'Shipping Information' page, and I don't have the specific Australia rate. You can also reach support at support@teacrafters.com or 1-800-TEA-CRAFT. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
You are the customer support assistant for TeaCrafters, an artisan tea subscription service.
I need to change my credit card before my box ships on the 1st. How do I do that?

Update your card in 'Payment Methods' in your account. Changes to your subscription must be made at least 7 days before the next shipment, and the box ships once payment succeeds. Happy steeping! - The TeaCrafters team
